title: EnumerationPlanV1 — Plan-bound expected population parameter (DRAFT, isolated successor)
description: Closed Draft 2020-12 parameter payload. Identity is raw SHA-256 of C(this record); not an H-domain. MUST NOT contain planId or analysisSpecDigest (parent-cycle). Cells are exactly analysis-spec requestedCapabilities ownership tuples. Program bindings are the Plan's explicit selected native resolved-input programs; U-1 default discovery does not enumerate every tsconfig variant. Exact typed admission (foundation/canonical.py) precedes validation. 4 MiB C-byte ceiling, no truncation. Standing: draft only; frozen21 and live repo untouched.

snapshotId.description: The analysed snapshot. Closure (not a field of this preimage's parent hash) requires equality with plan.snapshotId.

scopeDigest.description: raw SHA-256 of C(scope-descriptor). Closure requires equality with plan.scopeDigest.

membershipDigest.description: raw SHA-256 of C(UnitMembershipV1). The typed preimage is retained under that digest. Closure recomputes C(retained membership) and compares. No JSON Schema $ref is used here so this document remains independently keyed as a parameter (payload-registry keys by full document bytes).

x-opensip-uniqueness.law: Exactly the analysis-spec requestedCapabilities ownership tuples, including required. Duplicate tuples refuse. cellOrdinal is the 0-based index in this sorted array after admission; it is not stored on the cell (storing it would be a self-id).

x-opensip-parameter-registry-extension.note: analysis-spec.parameters[].schemaDigest is raw SHA-256 of this file's exact bytes; payloadDigest is raw SHA-256 of C(EnumerationPlanV1). Do not add a second $def from this document as another parameter row.

x-opensip-kind-derivation.note: kinds is stored on the cell. Candidate-only capabilities have an empty inventory kinds array; they still occupy one requestedCapabilities row and one cell. Empty kinds/extents do NOT mean complete-empty candidate work. Each available clones-near/clones-cross-tsjs binding MUST name candidateSourcePaths: the Plan-selected source-path census for that program, a subset of first-party scoped snapshot members under the cell workspace. Explicit [] is a selected empty census. Omitted field is not an empty census.

x-opensip-file-membership-extent-law.fileKind: Every remaining inventoried first-party snapshot path in the cell workspace/scope, including data-document, unsupported-file (no-bundled-grammar), extensionless, and syntax-only grammar-only members, regardless of compiler-mode program-member. Inventory is not grammar-gated.
x-opensip-file-membership-extent-law.symbolKind: Selected program/grammar CODE scope only: compiler-mode program-member paths whose suffix is a syntaxClass=code grammar, or syntax-only paths with a selected code grammar. Data-only selected symbol extents are lawful and may be complete-empty.
x-opensip-file-membership-extent-law.packageKind: First-party inventoried manifests only (package.json, Cargo.toml, and Cargo workspace memberPackageRoots manifests). Never node_modules, DependencySourceSet, or invented external snapshot paths.

x-opensip-new-internal-faults.standing: NEW/internal pending root public-registry integration. Not existing DomainDetailCode members.

WorkspaceRootText.description: Same type as analysis-spec.requestedCapabilities[].workspaceRoot (identity-schemas.v2.json#/$defs/Text). MAY be '.' for the admitted project root (native-evidence.md §1.4 normalize_explicit_root). NOT LogicalPath, which forbids a dot segment.

LogicalPath.description: Byte-identical constraint to identity-schemas.v2.json#/$defs/LogicalPath. File inventory paths, not workspaceRoot.

DeficiencyV2.description: Copied closed membership of native-evidence.schemas.v2.json#/$defs/DeficiencyV2. Drift vs that enum is a defect.

SelectedEnumeratorRef.description: A selected provider closure. Missing capability/provider selection for a required cell refuses pre-Plan (no fictional closure). Executable unavailability with this selected closure is UnavailableProgramBindingV1, not an unselected enumerator.

UnselectedEnumeratorRef.description: Optional-cell enumerator not selected. Lawful only on UnavailableProgramBindingV1 when the cell required=false. Not PROVIDER.NOT_SELECTED (matrix cell never mints a cell here). closureId is absent: a selected enumerator with a missing closure pointer is structural, not this shape.

EnumeratorRef.description: Available bindings may only use SelectedEnumeratorRef. Unavailable bindings may use either: selected+unavailable execution/input, or unselected optional-unselected when required=false.

paths.description: Per-kind expected paths. File, symbol and package extents MAY differ. Empty is lawful.

nativeContextDigest.description: Bare 64-hex suffix of the selected native context H identity. Must be a member of plan.nativeContextDigests at closure. NEW ENUMERATION_BINDING_CONTEXT_NOT_IN_PLAN if not. Outcome must not introduce a context this field did not name.

programEntry.description: TS/JS extra program: non-null LogicalPath of the selected inventoried config (snapshot member). U-1 default uses null; admission derives the actual U-1 marker/synthesized entry and compares it to retained TypeScriptConfigGraphV1.entryConfigPath (the graph entry need not be null). Rust extra programs are distinct universe H values (cfg/features/ownership); programEntry is not a complete program key. Resolved-input H remains authority.

candidateSourcePaths.description: Plan-selected candidate source-path census for clones-near/clones-cross-tsjs. Required on those cells' available bindings. Subset of first-party scoped snapshot members under the cell workspace. Not the whole monorepo unless the Plan selected that set. Explicit empty array is a selected zero-path census; omitting the field is not complete-empty work. Inventory cells must omit this field.

required.description: Copied from requestedCapabilities[].required (existing boolean ownership attribute). Required execution of this cell is independent of whether any policy rule is disabled.

programBindings.description: Contiguous ordinal 0..n-1. maxItems 128 is THIS array's bound, NOT plan.nativeContextDigests maxItems 128. Overflow refuses ENUMERATION_PLAN_PROGRAM_BINDINGS_OVERFLOW (NEW/internal). Multiple bindings per cell are allowed; one context never implies one universe. Duplicate available universe H inside one cell refuses ENUMERATION_BINDING_DUPLICATE_UNIVERSE. provenance=default-unit at most once and only at ordinal 0.
